topic: Open study (concept stage): Hs as a deterministic fleet-coherence + environmental-sensing layer for large LEO constellations (SpaceX/Starlink).
purpose: Local node for the constellation-navigation seed study -- the industrial/space arm proposing Hs for fleet navigation, drift/anomaly detection, collision-avoidance support, and dual-use upper-atmosphere science.
paths_note: key_files relative to THIS folder; join_the_chain relative to the Hs repo root.
status: SEED / CONCEPT -- no orbital-data run yet. Everything operational/scientific is T2 (reasoned) or T3 (exploratory) on top of P1's T1 engine facts. No numbers are claimed.

specific_knowledge.what: A constellation (~10,400 active Starlink, mid-2026, growing; SpaceX lowering/reconfiguring as conjunctions rise) read as a high-dimensional composition. Proposes: Fleet Coherence Index (FCI), kinematics->drag, spectral/wavelet anomaly detection, and the constellation-as-Earth-sensor dual-use (density/winds/gravity waves via drag; ionospheric scintillation via radio).
key_points: T1 foundation (from P1): D=4 quaternion exactness ~4.4e-16; O(log D) tiling to D=1e6 ~4.1e-12 (numerical, not bit-exact); determinism + hash receipts; HS-EPS-1 conformance.
T2 mappings: orbital deviations read compositionally; kinematics(P4)->drag; diameter->drift bound at fleet scale; standard Lomb-Scargle/wavelet/WPT+best-basis(Shannon) methods.
T3 (NO numbers): all fuel/risk/economic figures; gravity-wave/wind/scintillation detections; FCI dynamic range + lead time vs conjunction probability.

Precision wall: public TLEs suffice for FCI/storm-response tests; fine science (winds, gravity waves, density retrieval) needs high-precision ephemerides + ballistic coefficients (proprietary); scintillation needs radio metrics (proprietary).
specific_knowledge.claim_tiers: T1 = P1 engine facts only; T2 = the mappings onto orbital data; T3 = every operational/scientific magnitude. Promotion T3->T1 requires a public-data prototype with a content receipt.

next_step: Minimal FCI + spectral-anomaly prototype on PUBLIC data (Starlink TLEs + NOAA F10.7 + GFZ Kp), validated across a known geomagnetic storm window; compare a kinematics-derived drag proxy vs a standard atmospheric model. Only measured prototype output may leave Tier 3.
bring_your_own_ai: Start at README.md, then CONCEPT_AND_VALUE.md. Public data only (DATA_AND_SOURCES.md). Read-only context; governance + claim-tiers apply.
governance: HUF-STD-001; instrument not data; honest-broker (large vision, small claims; tier everything); complement not replacement for propagators/conjunction assessment; NO contact with or approach to SpaceX or any party -- Peter Higgins is the sole gate for all external steps; no AI commits/pushes/contacts.
